criteria.then: the URL is /lists/{id}?sort=title, "Title" is selected, and the books are listed as Animal Farm, Dune, The Hobbit; after a reload the same order and selection are shown

criteria.then: the owner page's Books section text contains no "Sort by", "Date added" or "Sort" control text and equals the share page's Books section text; the existing T4 checks (T4 AC1, AC3) still pass

criteria.then: books shown as "Unknown author" come last, and books with the same first author are ordered by title (case-insensitive), then by date added
the new book appears in the "Books" section at its title-sorted position (after the page updates or a reload of the same URL)

criteria.statement: The "Sort by" control fits the existing look of the list page, visually sits right after the "Books" heading (before the book items), is usable by keyboard, and does not cause horizontal overflow at phone, tablet and desktop widths.

interface.ui: On /lists/{id} (owner only), when the list has at least one book: a select labelled "Sort by" with exactly the options "Date added" (default), "Title", "Author", and a button "Sort" that applies the selection by navigating to /lists/{id}?sort=added, /lists/{id}?sort=title or /lists/{id}?sort=author respectively (an implementation may also apply the selection immediately on change, but the "Sort" button must work). Placement (owner decision): the "Sort by" select and "Sort" button are NOT inside the Books section element (the <section>/region that contains the h2 "Books" and the book items; the "Books" heading stays inside that element); they come right after the "Books" heading, i.e. after it in document order and before the "Share" section ("Link expires in") and "Search books", and they share a common container with the Books section that contains no h1. Consequently the text of the Books section (without its heading) contains only the book items (or "This list has no books yet.") and is identical on /lists/{id} (unsorted) and /s/{token} for the same list. GET /lists/{id}?sort=title and ?sort=author render the books in that order with the matching option pre-selected in "Sort by"; no sort parameter, sort=added, or any other/unknown value renders date-added order (oldest first, as before) with "Date added" selected and no error. Order rules: "Title" = ascending by title, case-insensitive; "Author" = ascending by the first listed author name as displayed (e.g. "Frank Herbert"), case-insensitive, with books shown as "Unknown author" last; ties are broken by title (case-insensitive), then by date added. Each book item keeps its existing content (title, author(s), first publish year). The share page /s/{token} is unchanged: no "Sort by" control, books in date-added order, and a sort query parameter on it is ignored. Verification fixture (owner decision): books are added through the UI with one book from each of the searches "tolkien", "dune" and "orwell" of the book test double, in this order: "The Hobbit" (J.R.R. Tolkien, 1937), "Dune" (Frank Herbert, 1965), "Animal Farm" (George Orwell, 1945). Expected orders: date added = The Hobbit, Dune, Animal Farm; Title = Animal Farm, Dune, The Hobbit; Author = Dune, Animal Farm, The Hobbit. Reused names: seeded user alice@example.test / Correct-Horse-1, "Sign in", "Sign out", "Name", "Create list", "Edit", "Save", "Delete list" (T2), "Search books" / "Search" / "Search results" / "Add" (T3), "Link expires in" / "Create share link" / "Share link" (T4), "This list has no books yet.".

non_goals: saving the sort order on the list or per user (no schema change)
sorting or a sort control on the share page /s/{token} (it keeps date-added order)
sorting on the lists index /lists or in book search results
descending order (Z-A) or sorting by other fields (e.g. first publish year)
surname-aware, article-ignoring ("The ...") or locale-specific collation rules beyond case-insensitive comparison
manual reordering (drag and drop) of books
changes to the book-search test double (gate/mocks/books.mjs) or to oracle/T4/check.mjs
shipping axe-core (or any accessibility-testing script) in the application, or changing the gate/harness (gate/**) to make AC8 measurable

scope.summary: On the owner's list page /lists/{id}, the owner can view the list's books sorted by title or by author instead of the default order (date added). The sort is a view-only choice (owner decision): it is carried in the page URL (query parameter sort) so it survives a reload and can be bookmarked, but it is not saved on the list, does not change the stored books, and does not affect the read-only share page /s/{token}, which keeps showing books in the order they were added. The "Sort by" control is placed right after the "Books" heading but outside the Books <section> element (owner decision), so that the Books section itself still holds only the books and reads the same on the owner page and the share page. Existing behaviour of the list page (T2-T4, T6) and its access rules are unchanged.

title: Sort books by title or author
